title.zh: RedotPay 拟于年底前秘密递交美股 IPO 申请
title.en: RedotPay reportedly plans confidential US IPO filing by year-end

current_state.zh: Hong Kong stablecoin payments company RedotPay is reportedly weighing a confidential SEC IPO filing before the end of the year while negotiating Pre-IPO funding at a $4–5B target valuation.
current_state.en: Hong Kong stablecoin payments company RedotPay is reportedly weighing a confidential SEC IPO filing before the end of the year while negotiating Pre-IPO funding at a $4–5B target valuation.

updates.title_zh: 💰 融资 |  香港加密支付卡公司Redotpay拟年底前秘密递交美股IPO申请，估值至少50亿美元
updates.title_en: 💰 融资 |  香港加密支付卡公司Redotpay拟年底前秘密递交美股IPO申请，估值至少50亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: Hong Kong-based crypto payment card issuer Redotpay is reportedly preparing to confidentially file for a US IPO by year-end at a targeted valuation of at least $5 billion, while negotiating a $4-5 billion Pre-IPO round, backed by 9M+ customers, $180M+ annualized revenue, and prior investors including Coinbase and Circle's venture arms.
